description: This PHP test class, PimDefinedReportAPITest, is part of the OrangeHRM project. It contains automated test cases for the PimDefinedReportAPI class, including methods for testing retrieval, filtering, creation, updating, and deletion of report data through API endpoints. The test class extends EndpointIntegrationTestCase and utilizes various fixtures and mock services to validate API behaviors.

classes.name: PimDefinedReportAPITest
classes.description: This class tests the PimDefinedReportAPI functionalities via various test methods such as getAll, getOne, create, update, delete, and filtered searches. It sets up necessary fixtures and mocks to facilitate integration testing.
